script_name: 被动扫描未授权访问（指定host版）
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

Host = cli.String("setHost", cli.setRequired(true))
cli.check()
print(Host)
yakit.EnableTable("数据对比", ["StatusCOde", "StatusCOde2","ContentLength","ContentLength2","body","body2"])

outputData = def(key, key2,key3,key4,key5,key6){
    data = make(map[string]var)
    data["StatusCOde"] = key
    data["StatusCOde2"] = key2
    data["ContentLength"] = key3
    data["ContentLength2"] = key4
    data["body"] = key5
    data["body2"] = key6
    yakit.Output(yakit.TableData("数据对比", data))
}

# mirrorFilteredHTTPFlow 劫持到的流量为 MITM 自动过滤出的可能和 "业务" 有关的流量，会自动过滤掉 js / css 等流量

mirrorFilteredHTTPFlow = func(isHttps /*bool*/, url /*string*/, req /*[]byte*/, rsp /*[]byte*/, body /*[]byte*/) {
    strreq = string(req)

    result3 = fuzz.HTTPRequest(strreq)~.ExecFirst()~
    print("-----------------------------------------")
    isHost = re.FindSubmatch(strreq, Host)
    print(len(isHost))
    if len(isHost) >= 1 {
        iscookie = re.FindSubmatch(strreq, `(?i)cookie:\s*(.*)`)
        if len(iscookie) >= 1 {
        result = fuzz.HTTPRequest(strreq)~.ExecFirst()~
        StatusCOde1 = string(result.Response.StatusCode)
    ContentLength1 = string(result.Response.ContentLength)
    body1 = string(result.Response.Body)
    print(body1)
    print(url)
# 这里的FuzzCookieRaw可以进行修改，懂的都懂，替换低权限cookie
    #result2 = fuzz.HTTPRequest(strreq)~.FuzzCookie("sission","1234567").ExecFirst()~
    result2 = fuzz.HTTPRequest(strreq)~.FuzzCookieRaw("123").ExecFirst()~
    StatusCOde2 = string(result2.Response.StatusCode)
    ContentLength2 = string(result2.Response.ContentLength)
    body2 = string(result2.Response.Body)
    print(body2)
    outputData(StatusCOde1,StatusCOde2, ContentLength1,ContentLength2,body1,body2)
    if StatusCOde1 == StatusCOde2 || ContentLength1 == ContentLength2 {
        risk.NewRisk(
        url,
        risk.title(sprintf("(Maybe) Unauthorized access: %v", url)),
        risk.titleVerbose("疑似检测到未授权访问接口"),
        risk.type("info"), risk.typeVerbose("疑似检测到未授权访问接口"),
        risk.description(`疑似检测到未授权访问接口`),
        risk.solution("添加认证校验"),
        risk.severity("low"),
        risk.request(result2.RequestRaw),
        risk.response(result2.ResponseRaw),
        risk.details({"body": body2}),
    )
    }
    }

    }

    
}
help: 仅检测指定的host页面，插件原理为替换请求头的cookie为 cookie:123，会重复发包比对替换后和替换前的响应码和返回包长度，如果一致则产生告警。
